newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac sets $935 mln of REMICs.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac sets $935 mln of REMICs.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp (Freddie Mac or FHLMC) said it issued $935 million of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) securities.

REMIC series 1932, underwritten by Merrill Lynch & Co, is backed by $350 million of 30-year single-family fixed-rate mortgages, Freddie Mac said. The issue has a coupon of 7.5 percent, a pricing date of January 14 and a settlement date of February 28, FHLMC said.

REMIC series 1933, underwritten by Bear Stearns & Co, is backed by $585 million of 30-year single-family fixed-rate mortgages, the agency said. The issue has a coupon of 7.5 percent, a pricing date of January 16 and a settlement date of February 28, it said.
